words.definition: n. 租约；vt. 出租；租借

examples.en: The company signed a ten-year lease for the new office building.
examples.zh: 公司为新办公楼签了十年租约。

examples.en: They lease the land from a local farmer at a low rent.
examples.zh: 他们以低租金向当地一位农民租用土地。

words.usage: 搭配：sign a lease（签租约）、lease sth from sb（租入）、lease sth to sb（租出）；商业语境常考。派生：lessee n. 承租人；lessor n. 出租人
collocations: sign a lease 签订租约
lease a flat from sb 向某人租公寓
a long-term lease 长期租约
words.mnemonic: l+ease（轻松）→轻松搞定住房→租约

words.definition: n. 婴儿；adj. 婴儿的；初期的

examples.en: The clinic provides free vaccinations for infants under one year old.
examples.zh: 该诊所为一岁以下婴儿免费接种疫苗。

examples.en: The online retail industry was still in its infancy then.
examples.zh: 当时网络零售业尚处于起步阶段。

words.usage: 高频搭配：infant mortality（婴儿死亡率）、in one's infancy（处于初创期）；经济学考点 infant industry（幼稚产业）。派生：infancy n. 婴儿期
collocations: infant mortality 婴儿死亡率
in one's infancy 处于初创期
infant industry 幼稚产业
words.mnemonic: in（不）+fant（说）→还不会说话→婴儿

words.definition: vt. 卸（货）；倾吐；抛售

examples.en: Dockers unloaded crates of fruit from the ship.
examples.zh: 码头工人从船上卸下一箱箱水果。

examples.en: Investors unloaded their shares as the crisis deepened.
examples.zh: 随着危机加剧，投资者纷纷抛售股票。

words.usage: 本义卸货；引申「倾诉」unload one's troubles on sb，「抛售」unload shares；反义 load。顺带记词族 download（下载）、upload（上传）。
collocations: unload the cargo 卸货
unload on sb 向某人倾诉
unload shares 抛售股票
words.mnemonic: un（反）+load（装）→把装的卸下→卸货

words.definition: n. 汽笛；警报器；诱惑物

examples.en: We heard the wail of sirens as fire engines rushed past.
examples.zh: 消防车疾驰而过，警笛声凄厉。

examples.en: Free gifts are often just a siren song to attract customers.
examples.zh: 免费赠品往往只是吸引顾客的诱饵。

words.usage: 常见搭配 sound a siren（鸣笛）；希腊神话中海妖 Siren 以歌声诱人，故 siren song 比喻「致命诱惑」，阅读修辞题常涉及。
collocations: sound a siren 鸣响警报
an air-raid siren 空袭警报器
a siren song 诱人的诱惑
words.mnemonic: 海妖 Siren 歌声摄魂→警报摄人→汽笛

words.definition: vt. 加固；增强，强化

examples.en: The bridge was reinforced with steel bars to withstand earthquakes.
examples.zh: 大桥用钢筋加固以抵御地震。

examples.en: The study reinforces the view that sleep aids memory.
examples.zh: 这项研究强化了睡眠有助记忆的观点。

words.usage: 阅读高频于观点句：reinforce the idea/belief that…；工程义「加固」见 reinforced concrete（钢筋混凝土）。派生：reinforcement n. 加强
collocations: reinforce the belief 强化信念
reinforced concrete 钢筋混凝土
reinforce the troops 增援部队
words.mnemonic: re（再）+in+force（力）→再加把力→加固

words.definition: n. 统治时期；vi. 统治；盛行

examples.en: The country prospered during the long reign of Queen Victoria.
examples.zh: 在维多利亚女王漫长的统治时期，国家繁荣昌盛。

examples.en: After the storm, confusion reigned throughout the airport.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，机场一片混乱。

words.usage: 搭配 under the reign of（在…统治下）、reign over（统治）；引申「弥漫、盛行」：Silence reigned（一片寂静）。与同音词 rain、rein 需辨形。
collocations: reign over 统治
under the reign of 在…统治时期
confusion reigned 一片混乱
words.mnemonic: 同音三分：rain 雨、rein 缰绳、reign 王政

words.definition: n. 政权；管理制度

examples.en: The military regime restricted press freedom for years.
examples.zh: 军政权多年来限制新闻自由。

examples.en: Patients are advised to follow a strict exercise regime.
examples.zh: 建议病人遵循严格的锻炼方案。

words.usage: 政治语境常带贬义：the old regime、an authoritarian regime；另指养生或训练「制度」：a health regime。勿与 region（地区）混淆。
collocations: the military regime 军事政权
under the new regime 在新体制下
a training regime 训练计划
words.mnemonic: reg（统治）+ime→统治之法→政权、制度

words.definition: adv. 不顾后果地；adj. 不留心的

examples.en: The festival will be held as planned, regardless of the weather.
examples.zh: 无论天气如何，庆典都将如期举行。

examples.en: He kept working regardless of the doctor's warnings.
examples.zh: 他不顾医生的警告，仍然坚持工作。

words.usage: 核心短语 regardless of（不管，后接名词或从句），完形与阅读高频；义近 in spite of，但语气更中性。派生：regard v. 看待
collocations: regardless of 不顾，无论
regardless of cost 不惜代价
regardless of the consequences 不顾后果
words.mnemonic: regard（在意）+less（无）→毫不在意→不管

words.definition: n. 拇指；v. 翻阅；搭便车

examples.en: He thumbed through the report quickly before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前他快速翻阅了那份报告。

examples.en: They stood by the road, trying to thumb a ride to town.
examples.zh: 他们站在路边，想搭便车进城。

words.usage: 习语高频：thumb through（翻阅）、thumb a lift/ride（搭便车）、all thumbs（笨手笨脚）、green thumb（园艺高手，美式口语）。
collocations: thumb through 翻阅
thumb a ride 搭便车
all thumbs 笨手笨脚
words.mnemonic: 拇指一竖可搭车、一翻可浏览→thumb

words.definition: adj. 红外线的；n. 红外线

examples.en: The satellite detects infrared radiation from distant galaxies.
examples.zh: 这颗卫星探测来自遥远星系的红外辐射。

examples.en: An infrared camera captured the suspect's body heat at night.
examples.zh: 红外相机在夜间拍到了嫌疑人的体温。

words.usage: 科技阅读高频：infrared radiation/detector/camera；与 ultraviolet（紫外线的）按光谱对记：红外在红光之外，紫外在紫光之外。
collocations: infrared radiation 红外辐射
an infrared detector 红外探测器
infrared rays 红外线
words.mnemonic: infra（在下）+red（红）→红光之外→红外线

words.definition: vt. 看待；n. 尊重；问候

examples.en: She is widely regarded as one of the finest novelists of her generation.
examples.zh: 她被普遍认为是同代人中最杰出的小说家之一。

examples.en: Please give my regards to your parents.
examples.zh: 请代我向你父母问好。

words.usage: 最高频结构 regard…as…（把…视为），常用于被动 be regarded as；短语 in/with regard to（关于）；hold sb in high regard（敬重）。
collocations: regard as 把…视为
in regard to 关于
with best regards 谨致问候
words.mnemonic: re（再）+gard（看）→反复端详→看待、敬重

words.definition: n. 武器；斗争工具

examples.en: Education is the most powerful weapon against poverty.
examples.zh: 教育是对抗贫困最有力的武器。

examples.en: The police found no weapon at the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 警方在犯罪现场没有发现凶器。

words.usage: 常用搭配 nuclear weapons（核武器）；比喻 a weapon against sth；double-edged weapon（双刃剑）。派生：weaponry n. 武器总称
collocations: nuclear weapons 核武器
a double-edged weapon 双刃剑
a weapon against poverty 对抗贫困的武器
words.mnemonic: 谐音「威炮」：有威力的炮→武器

words.definition: n. 废旧物品；vt. 丢弃

examples.en: Cutting down on junk food can improve your health considerably.
examples.zh: 少吃垃圾食品能大大改善健康。

examples.en: They junked the old proposal and started from scratch.
examples.zh: 他们废弃了旧方案，从头再来。

words.usage: 高频合成词：junk food/mail（垃圾食品/邮件）、a junk shop（旧货店）；动词义口语「扔掉」：junk the plan。近义 rubbish（英）、garbage（美）。
collocations: junk food 垃圾食品
junk mail 垃圾邮件
junk the plan 废弃计划
words.mnemonic: 先记 junk food 垃圾食品，再由「无用」引申丢弃

words.definition: vt. 提名；任命

examples.en: The film was nominated for best picture at the awards.
examples.zh: 该片获得颁奖典礼最佳影片提名。

examples.en: Each department will nominate one representative to the committee.
examples.zh: 每个部门将提名一名代表进入委员会。

words.usage: 高频结构 nominate sb for/as（提名/任命某人为）；派生：nomination n. 提名；nominee n. 被提名者。同根词 nominal（名义上的）。
collocations: nominate sb for 提名某人为候选
nominate sb as 任命某人为
be nominated for an award 获奖项提名
words.mnemonic: nomin（名）+ate→使其有名分→提名

words.definition: adj. 同时发生的；同步的

examples.en: The treaty requires simultaneous reductions in nuclear arsenals.
examples.zh: 该条约要求同步削减核武库。

examples.en: The conference offers simultaneous interpretation in six languages.
examples.zh: 会议提供六种语言的同声传译。

words.usage: 高频搭配 simultaneous interpretation（同声传译）；be simultaneous with（与…同时）。派生：simultaneously adv. 同时地，阅读高频副词。
collocations: simultaneous interpretation 同声传译
simultaneous with 与…同时
simultaneous explosions 同时爆炸
words.mnemonic: simul（相同）+taneous→同一时刻→同时的

words.definition: n. 噩梦；可怕的经历

examples.en: Losing all the data was an administrative nightmare for the office.
examples.zh: 数据尽失，对办公室来说是一场行政噩梦。

examples.en: Driving downtown at rush hour is a real nightmare.
examples.zh: 高峰时段开车进城真是噩梦一场。

words.usage: have a nightmare（做噩梦）；比喻义极常用：a nightmare scenario（噩梦般的局面）、the journey was a nightmare。派生：nightmarish adj. 可怕的
collocations: have a nightmare 做噩梦
a nightmare scenario 噩梦般的局面
a traffic nightmare 交通噩梦
words.mnemonic: night（夜）+mare（魔）→夜里被魔缠→噩梦

words.definition: adj. 传染的；有感染力的

examples.en: Vaccination remains the best defence against infectious diseases.
examples.zh: 接种疫苗仍是预防传染病最好的手段。

examples.en: Her infectious enthusiasm spread to the whole team.
examples.zh: 她富有感染力的热情传遍了全队。

words.usage: 高频搭配 infectious diseases（传染病）；比喻义 an infectious laugh（有感染力的笑）。辨析：contagious 侧重接触传染。派生：infection n. 感染
collocations: infectious diseases 传染病
an infectious laugh 有感染力的笑
infectious enthusiasm 感染性热情
words.mnemonic: in（进）+fect（做）+ious→进来作乱→传染

words.definition: n. 楔子；vt. 挤入

examples.en: The dispute drove a wedge between the two former allies.
examples.zh: 这场争端在两个昔日盟友之间造成了裂痕。

examples.en: She wedged the suitcase into the already packed trunk.
examples.zh: 她把行李箱硬塞进已塞满的后备箱。

words.usage: 习语 drive a wedge between（离间、制造隔阂）为阅读高频；a wedge of lemon（一角柠檬）；动词表硬挤、塞入狭窄空间。
collocations: drive a wedge between 挑间离
a wedge of lemon 一角柠檬
wedge open 楔住使敞开
words.mnemonic: w+edge（边）→从边缝劈入→楔子；谐音「喂挤」

words.definition: n. 技工，机械师；运作方法

examples.en: The mechanic checked the engine and replaced a worn belt.
examples.zh: 修理工检查了发动机，换掉了一根磨损的皮带。

examples.en: We called a mechanic after the car broke down on the highway.
examples.zh: 车在高速路上抛锚后，我们叫来了修理工。

words.usage: 本义「修理工」；the mechanics of sth 指「具体运作方法」。勿与 mechanical（adj. 机械的；呆板的）、mechanism（n. 机制）混用。
collocations: a car mechanic 汽车修理工
a skilled mechanic 熟练技工
call a mechanic 叫修理工
words.mnemonic: mechan（机器）+ic→摆弄机器的人→技工

words.definition: n. 绰号，昵称；vt. 给…起绰号

examples.en: His classmates nicknamed him Professor for his great love of books.
examples.zh: 他酷爱读书，同学们便给他起了「教授」的绰号。

examples.en: The city earned the nickname City of Springs for its fountains.
examples.zh: 这座城市因泉眼众多而赢得「泉城」的绰号。

words.usage: 搭配 give sb a nickname（起外号）、be nicknamed…（被称为…）；名词前常由物主代词修饰：his nickname。由古英语 an ekename 误拆而来。
collocations: give sb a nickname 给某人起绰号
be nicknamed 被称为
by the nickname of 以…的绰号
words.mnemonic: nick（刻）+name（名）→名字上再刻一笔→绰号
